description: Estimate the gas a transaction would use on Polygon PoS (eth_estimateGas) and what it would cost at the current gas price, in gas units, gwei and POL. Give to, plus value in POL and calldata for a contract call, and the sender when the call depends on it. Use before sending a transaction or to price a batch; for the gas price alone use polygon_gas. A transaction that would revert is 422 with the reason, uncharged. Example: to=0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

data.description: Optional 0x calldata for a contract call

value.description: Amount of POL to send, in POL (default 0)

name: polygon_estimate_gas
title: Estimate gas, Polygon
